kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Lab Med 2026;57:lmaf096 · 回顾性
title: Utility of PAX1/JAM3 Methylation for Triage of hrHPV-Positive Individuals
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化分流 hrHPV 阳性人群的价值
subtitle: 312 hrHPV+ individuals — CIN2+ sensitivity 91.8% / specificity 90.7% (AUC 0.912), 1.22 referrals per CIN2+
subtitle_zh: 312 例 hrHPV+ 人群——CIN2+ 灵敏度 91.8% / 特异度 90.7%（AUC 0.912），每例 CIN2+ 仅 1.22 次转诊
authors: Guo Q, Wang H, Diao X, Liu Y, et al.
authors_zh: 郭琴, 王华国, 刁雪, 刘英红 等

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: hrHPV positivity triggers management decisions — but cytology triage is subjective and HPV16/18 typing alone under-performs.
Question: what is the real-world utility of PAX1m/JAM3m for triaging hrHPV+ individuals?
Why it matters: quantifying referral efficiency helps screening programs plan capacity.
bullets_zh: 空白：hrHPV 阳性触发管理决策——但细胞学分流主观，单独 HPV16/18 分型表现不足。
问题：PAX1m/JAM3m 分流 hrHPV+ 人群的真实世界价值如何？
意义：量化转诊效率有助于筛查项目规划容量。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: retrospective cross-sectional (Jan 2024–Jun 2025); Ziyang Central Hospital.
Population: 312 hrHPV+ (mean 49 y): 194 cervicitis / 20 CIN1 / 20 CIN2 / 31 CIN3 / 37 SCC / 10 adenocarcinoma.
Methylation: PAX1m/JAM3m (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 / ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); HPV genotyping (Shanghai ZJ); LBC.
Outcome: CIN2+ detection + referral efficiency.
bullets_zh: 设计：回顾性横断面（2024.1–2025.6）；资阳市中心医院。
人群：hrHPV+ 312 例（平均 49 岁）：宫颈炎 194 / CIN1 20 / CIN2 20 / CIN3 31 / 鳞癌 37 / 腺癌 10。
甲基化：PAX1m/JAM3m（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 / ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；HPV 分型（上海之江）；LBC。
结局：CIN2+ 检出 + 转诊效率。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CIN2+: sensitivity 91.8% · specificity 90.7% · PPV 81.8% · NPV 96.0% · AUC 0.912 — above cytology (AUC 0.638) and HPV16/18 (0.642).
Cancer detection: 100% of SCC and adenocarcinoma methylation-positive.
Referral efficiency: 1.22 referrals per CIN2+ detected; referral rate down 19.2% vs LBC, CIN2+ yield up 39.4%.
Gradient: methylation positivity rose with lesion grade (trend P<0.001).
bullets_zh: CIN2+：灵敏度 91.8% · 特异度 90.7% · PPV 81.8% · NPV 96.0% · AUC 0.912——高于细胞学（AUC 0.638）与 HPV16/18（0.642）。
癌症检出：鳞癌与腺癌甲基化阳性率均为 100%。
转诊效率：每检出 1 例 CIN2+ 仅 1.22 次转诊；转诊率较 LBC 降低 19.2%，CIN2+ 检出率提高 39.4%。
梯度：甲基化阳性率随病变分级升高（趋势 P<0.001）。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Efficiency: ~1 referral per CIN2+ — nearly every colposcopy finds disease, minimizing wasted procedures.
Non-16/18 subgroup: −34.3% referrals and +44.4% CIN2+ yield vs LBC — best where triage is weakest.
Actionable: supports methylation as the primary triage for hrHPV+ individuals in real-world practice.
bullets_zh: 效率：每例 CIN2+ 约 1 次转诊——几乎每次阴道镜都能发现病变，浪费极少。
非16/18亚组：较 LBC 转诊 −34.3%、CIN2+ 检出 +44.4%——恰在分流最弱处最优。
可操作：支持甲基化作为 hrHPV+ 人群真实世界实践中的首选分流。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: High accuracy + high efficiency: AUC 0.912 with 1.22 referrals per CIN2+ and 100% cancer detection.
Real-world fit: methylation triage improves yield and cuts referrals simultaneously in routine hrHPV+ care.
bullets_zh: 高准确性 + 高效率：AUC 0.912，每例 CIN2+ 仅 1.22 次转诊，癌症检出 100%。
真实世界适配：甲基化分流在日常 hrHPV+ 诊疗中同时提高检出、减少转诊。

kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Am J Cancer Res 2026;16(4):1495–1508 · 综述
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation — A Novel Biomarker for Cervical Adenocarcinoma
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化——宫颈腺癌早检与精准管理的新型标志物
subtitle: A narrative review — methylation fills the screening gap for adenocarcinomas, ~15% of which are HPV-negative
subtitle_zh: 叙述性综述——甲基化填补腺癌筛查缺口，约 15% 腺癌 HPV 阴性
authors: Feng S, Wang D, He Q, An Y, Li S, Liu L
authors_zh: 冯淑娴, 王丹, 何倩楠, 安雨声, 李赛男, 刘玲
source: Am J Cancer Res 2026;16(4):1495–1508 · DOI 10.62347/SATU5579
source_zh: Am J Cancer Res 2026;16(4):1495–1508 · DOI 10.62347/SATU5579

panels.title: Why this review
bullets: Problem: cervical adenocarcinoma (10–25% of cervical cancers, ~15% HPV-negative) is often missed by HPV/cytology screening and has worse outcomes.
Mechanism: PAX1 (Wnt/TCF7L2, tumor suppressor) and JAM3 (Hippo, HIF-1α/VEGFA) methylation silence key pathways in adenocarcinomas.
Scope: review methylation's role from early detection to risk stratification, therapy response and prognosis.
bullets_zh: 问题：宫颈腺癌（占宫颈癌 10–25%，约 15% HPV 阴性）常被 HPV/细胞学筛查漏诊，预后更差。
机制：PAX1（Wnt/TCF7L2，抑癌）与 JAM3（Hippo、HIF-1α/VEGFA）甲基化沉默腺癌关键通路。
范围：综述甲基化从早检到风险分层、疗效与预后的全程作用。

panels.title: Screening evidence
bullets: PAX1 accuracy: CIN2+/CIN3+ detection AUC up to 0.88; 100% sensitivity for CIN2+/CIN3+ in HPV16/18-negative women.
HPV16/18+ cohort: CIN2+ 89.0% sens / 95.3% spec with ~50–60% fewer referrals.
Postmenopausal: CIN2+ 93.2% / CIN3+ 97.2% — strong in atrophic cytology.
ASC-US/LSIL: dual-gene 83.8% / 95.8% — objective triage for low-grade results.
bullets_zh: PAX1 准确性：CIN2+/CIN3+ 检出 AUC 最高 0.88；HPV16/18 阴性女性中 CIN2+/CIN3+ 灵敏度 100%。
HPV16/18+ 队列：CIN2+ 89.0% 灵敏度 / 95.3% 特异度，转诊减少约 50–60%。
绝经后：CIN2+ 93.2% / CIN3+ 97.2%——萎缩细胞学下表现强劲。
ASC-US/LSIL：双基因 83.8% / 95.8%——低级别结果的客观分流。

panels.title: Management & prognosis
bullets: Recurrence prediction: JAM3 methylation predicted CIN2/3 post-op recurrence with 94.8% sens / 93.7% spec.
HSIL+: PAX1 methylation detected HSIL+ with AUC 0.919.
Full pathway: methylation supports screening → triage → treatment monitoring → recurrence surveillance across the care continuum.
bullets_zh: 复发预测：JAM3 甲基化预测 CIN2/3 术后复发，灵敏度 94.8% / 特异度 93.7%。
HSIL+：PAX1 甲基化检测 HSIL+ AUC 0.919。
全程管理：甲基化支持筛查 → 分流 → 治疗监测 → 复发随访的完整照护路径。

panels.title: Adenocarcinoma gap
bullets: Why methylation fits: adenocarcinomas arise in the endocervix — cytology samples them poorly; HPV tests miss HPV-negative tumors.
Methylation advantage: host-gene methylation is present regardless of HPV status — covering the HPV-negative adenocarcinoma niche.
Future: multi-center studies to standardize cut-offs and integrate methylation into screening guidelines.
bullets_zh: 为何甲基化契合：腺癌源于宫颈管——细胞学取样差；HPV 检测漏诊 HPV 阴性肿瘤。
甲基化优势：宿主基因甲基化与 HPV 状态无关——覆盖 HPV 阴性腺癌空缺。
未来：多中心研究标准化界值并将甲基化纳入筛查指南。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Fills the adenocarcinoma gap: host methylation detects HPV-negative and endocervical tumors that HPV/cytology miss.
One biomarker, full pathway: from early detection (AUC 0.88+) to recurrence prediction (94.8%/93.7%) — complete management support.
bullets_zh: 填补腺癌缺口：宿主甲基化可检出 HPV/细胞学漏诊的 HPV 阴性及宫颈管肿瘤。
单一标志物，全程路径：从早检（AUC 0.88+）到复发预测（94.8%/93.7%）——完整管理支持。
